_comment: What differs between Facebook, Instagram and Threads — one list read by the composer (lib/socialPlatforms.js: counters, warnings, previews) and by the backend (api/_postgen/renderers/social.py: the IG / Threads variants it renders, api/index.py: which platforms exist). Bundled with the Python function via vercel.json includeFiles and copied into the API image by Dockerfile.api.

platforms.label: Facebook
platforms.hint: 連結可點。字數寬鬆，但超過 3 行就會被折疊成「查看更多」。影片一則只能放一支，且不能和圖片混放。

platforms.label: Instagram
platforms.hint: 一定要有圖片或影片。單支影片會發成 Reels。內文連結不可點，請改寫成「報名連結在個人簡介」。

platforms.label: Threads
platforms.hint: 上限 500 字，口語為主，hashtag 越少越好。多個項目會發成輪播。
